name: com.aham.luajitmr
description: Turn any Android phone into a 6DoF MR headset with Cardboard viewer, passthrough via ARCore, MediaPipe hand tracking, and a WebXR runtime for the same content in the browser. Clean zero-boilerplate API: drop LuaJITMRPlayer into any scene and call LuaJITMR.SetMode(XRMode.MR).

samples.description: Minimal scene: drop LuaJITMRPlayer, gaze-and-dwell at a floating cube.
Switch VR ⇄ MR, place anchors on detected planes.
Pinch to grab and throw objects using MediaPipe hand tracking.
Curved glassmorphism UI with gaze, pinch, and poke input.
Same scene built for WebGL, runs in immersive-vr / immersive-ar in the browser.
Arm-reach climbing locomotion with procedural obstacle course. Works with hands, controller or gaze.
Rhythm game with two colored sabers, note spawning, slice detection, score and haptics.
